newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen says board to decide on restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen says board to decide on restructuring plan.

text.p: German steelmaker and diversified industrial group Thyssen AG said on Tuesday that its supervisory board would decide on Friday on plans to reorganize the group.

The Thyssen spokesman would not specify the exact changes to be discussed, but described as "speculation" a magazine report which said that any Thyssen units which did not generate returns of 12.5 percent would be restructured, sold off or closed.

A report in the German magazine Manager went on to say that the group was planning to trim back its units to focus on its core business, and that its engineering, coal, petroleum, shipbuilding and steelmaking divisions would be the main focus of the restructuring.
